1.content: The White Moon is a sacred spiritual and political title held by the Dominant Omega closest to the Firstborn bloodline, equivalent to the Queen of the Wolves to Wulfnic's King, carrying immense crushing religious authority. Inherited from the late Nixara Bloodmoon, the title now falls to {{user}}, granting absolute immunity to Alpha Command and a terrifying destiny they desperately wish to escape in favor of a normal life. Her saliva accelerates tissue regeneration, and as the "Mother of all Wolves", her breasts naturally produce milk upon reaching maturity to feed orphaned pups, even without pregnancy.

2.content: The Pack of Seven Hills is a militarized conglomerate operating since 1666 out of the Douglas Commercial Coalition (DCC), combining billionaire corporate power with ancient LSE hierarchy. They hold exclusive global patents in adapting modern technology for supernatural biology: fire-proof smartphones, hybrid-accommodating vehicles, and LSE-compliant architecture. Their singular objective is absolute control over the user's environment—framed as protective paternalism but functionally trauma-based confinement. Threats trigger immediate non-negotiable response via Kaladin's PMC strike teams, executing flawless, overwhelming extractions.

4.content:
DOCUMENTED WHITE MOONS

The following individuals have been confirmed as White Moon Dominant Omegas by the Living Sagas or unanimous Moon Speaker consensus. The list is almost certainly incomplete — the Age of Secrecy likely suppressed documentation of several cases.

NIXARA BLOODMOON — THE MOST RECENT WHITE MOON

IDENTITY CARD:
- Blood Classification: Founding Blood
- Secondary Sex: Dominant Omega
- Designation: White Moon
- House: Bloodmoon
- Status: Deceased
- Anointed by: Wulfnic Bloodmoon (First Fang)

Nixara Bloodmoon is the most recently confirmed White Moon in the species record. A Founding Bloodline Dominant Omega of House Bloodmoon, she was recognized and formally Anointed by the First Fang (Wulfnic Bloodmoon) — the first White Moon Anointing conducted by a Living Saga in over three centuries.

THE CACCIA-CONFIRMED BOND:
Nixara's last participation in La Grande Caccia as a free White Moon was the cycle of approximately 1994. At that Great Hunt, Erik Douglas found her in the forest. Their bond was Caccia-confirmed — the highest theological recognition in the Faith of Fenris, protected from political interference by species law. They married formally in 1996.

DEATH:
Nixara died April 22, 2005, giving birth to twins ({{user}} and Jasper Douglas-Bloodmoon). Erik Douglas has survived the breaking of a Caccia-confirmed Mate Bond. That he did so is biologically extraordinary; the grief has never left his body.

LEGACY:
The LSE record establishes only the institutional facts: she was confirmed as White Moon. Her bond was Caccia-confirmed. She was the last White Moon to run free in La Grande Caccia before her death. Whether a successor has been identified remains open to setting-specific documentation.

Her Anointing has not been revoked. The title of White Moon is non-transferable — it is a biological designation, not an office. A new White Moon, if one emerges, would be separately recognized.

The 1994 Caccia cycle is the last species-confirmed date on which a White Moon Dominant Omega participated in La Grande Caccia.

24.content: LSE is the definitive modular framework defining werewolf biology, ecology, society, governance, religion, and history. LSE modules expand independently. LSE remains strictly setting-agnostic; worlds like Svartúlfr apply LSE rules to their context. LSE separates biology, history, religion, and culture. This separation enables scientists, atheists, heretics, and cultists to coexist within the werewolf canonical framework.

25.content: LSE canon operates through three hierarchical mechanisms. Core Canon establishes absolute werewolf species ground truth via LSE modules. Setting Canon defines world-specific content such as Svartúlfr's Bloodmoon Dynasty. Narrative Canon encompasses roleplay storytelling events. Core Canon supersedes Setting Canon. Setting Canon supersedes Narrative Canon.

26.content: Blood Classification is an immutable genetic hierarchy defined by LSE Core Canon. Divine Blood designates the Nine Firstborn; their origin remains contested between Religious Canon (Fenris-forged) and Recorded History (Viking Age emergence), rendering it Unknown Truth. Pureblood Houses are direct Firstborn descendants who established Great Houses. Pureblood Houses represent stable, multi-generational Firstborn descent. Common Bloodlines constitute the population majority. Modified Lineages denote experimentally altered subjects, exemplified by Gamma-7.

27.content: Pheromones function as chemical signals conveying status, mood, and sexual intent. The Knot, a bulbous glandis on Alpha and Enigma penises, swells during intercourse to bind partners. A Baculum (os penis) is exclusively present in Alphas and Enigmas of Pureblood, Founding, and Divine bloodlines, and Betas/Deltas strictly of Founding/Divine lines. Slick is the self-lubricant produced by Omega werewolves during arousal. A Bonding Mark (Mating Mark) is a bite creating a permanent mental-emotional link between partners. A Nest is an Omega-constructed safe space for comfort and childbirth. A Den is an Alpha's scent-marked personal territory.

28.content: Recorded History explicitly documents bloodline classifications for all major werewolves. Recorded History strictly tracks the Nine Firstborn and their direct genetic descendants.

29.content: LSE Module 6 (History) defines werewolf historical eras and the Secrecy protocol governing human-world concealment. Recorded History confirms werewolf emergence in the Viking Age via nine Firstborn individuals. Religious Canon asserts Fenris forged the Nine Firstborn from mortal warriors. Unknown Truth leaves Fenris's physical existence permanently ambiguous. Module 7 (Figures) catalogs the Nine Firstborn and Wulfnic as primary historical agents. Module 8 (Technology) standardizes werewolf-specific Industry and Architecture, including synthetic pheromone synthesis, reinforced construction for transformation stress, and pack-infrastructure logistics. All modules adhere to LSE setting-agnostic design; Svartúlfr applies these rules via Bloodmoon Dynasty Setting Canon. Core Canon supersedes Setting Canon supersedes Narrative Canon.

30.comment: Tier 1 - LSE_Appendix - ∑ Enigma — The Sacred Caste
30.content: The Enigma sacred caste comprises exclusively the Nine Firstborn. Primordial Enigmas are divine, unique beings that cannot be replicated or reproduced. Primordial Enigma biology permanently transcends all standard werewolf species parameters.

31.comment: Tier 1 - LSE_Appendix - α Alpha — The Protector
31.content: Alpha werewolves possess a penis with an inflatable bulbous glandis (knot) that locks with a partner during intercourse to maximize conception. Male Alphas of Pureblood, Founding, or Divine bloodlines also possess a baculum (os penis). Alphas undergo a monthly rut lasting three to ten days, marked by intensified pheromones and aggression. Unlike Omegas in heat, Alphas generally control rut behavior to avoid societal disruption. Alphas constitute approximately ten percent of the werewolf population.

32.comment: Tier 1 - LSE_Appendix - β Beta — The Social Glue
32.content: Betas balance Alpha protective instincts and Omega nurturing instincts without dominance by either. This biological equilibrium makes Betas superior social adapters. Beta scent glands located at neck and wrists emit subdued pheromonal signatures. Primary biological gender impacts Beta physiology more significantly than Alpha or Omega physiology. Female Betas undergo standard monthly menstruation lasting three to seven days. Male Betas of Founding or Divine bloodlines possess a baculum (os penis).

33.content: The White Moon is a rare Omega-caste variant functioning as the apex stabilizer for massive multi-pack or politically fractured crises. Historically, every White Moon bonds as mate or spiritual partner to the ruling Enigma, forming the "King and the Moon" pairing. Rarity limits White Moons to one per bloodline generation maximum. White Moons never manifest in Common Bloodlines.

34.content: Lifespan is determined strictly by Blood Classification. Common Bloodlines live 80 to 150 years. Pureblood Houses live 200 to 400 years. Pureblood Houses exceed 500 years. Divine Blood individuals possess biological immortality, confirmed beyond 1,000 years.

35.content: Werewolf genetic architecture permits rare Mutations yielding unexpected traits. Specific Bloodline Traits bind exclusively to particular Noble Houses. Genetic Diseases target the werewolf species specifically. Hybrids—offspring of werewolves and other supernatural species—remain extremely rare and highly controversial.

36.content: Scent glands are epidermal structures secreting pheromones for communication, dominance, and reproduction. Location, density, sensitivity, and output depend on secondary sex (Alpha, Delta, Beta, Omega, Enigma) and developmental stage. Gamma juveniles have undifferentiated glands; Presentation triggers sex-specific maturation. Alphas possess high-concentration glands at neck, jaw, wrists for territorial marking. Omegas concentrate glands at inner thighs, neck, wrists to release bonding and heat-cycle pheromones. Deltas and Betas show moderate, functional glandular distribution. Enigmas possess supreme glandular development; their scent suppresses Enigma expression continent-wide. Blood classification amplifies potency: Divine and Pureblood Houses produce exponentially stronger output. Glands respond involuntarily to emotional states—stress, arousal, aggression—and voluntarily for social signaling.

37.content: Werewolves occupy three morphological states: Partial Shift (voluntary or emotional lupine traits, human cognition), Hybrid Shift (true form, digitigrade, full fur, maximum strength and speech), and Full Shift (quadrupedal wolf, hunting specialization, non-verbal). Blood classification is immutable: Divine Blood confers biological immortality, extreme regeneration, absolute Command; Pureblood Houses exhibit exceptional longevity and genetic stability; Pureblood Houses maintain aristocratic dominance and long lifespans; Common Lineages possess standard biology; Modified Lineages display unpredictable artificial alterations. Secondary sex manifests at age 13: Gamma features neutral pre-presentation dual genitalia; Enigma represents a sacred caste with suppressed expression, superior Command and pheromones, limited to one per generation; Alpha embodies protector instincts, territorial competitiveness, high pheromonal presence without automatic leadership authority.

38.content: Werewolf behavior is biologically determined by secondary sex and blood classification. Alphas display territorial, protective instincts but lack automatic leadership. Enigmas dominate all sexes including Alphas with superior Command intensity. Gammas are pre-presentation neutrals using neutral pronouns. Shift classes define behavioral contexts: Partial Shift for social signaling; Hybrid Shift (true form) for combat and ceremonies; Full Shift for hunting and pack formations. Blood classification regulates lifespan, regeneration, Command affinity, and pack bond strength. Divine Bloods possess biological immortality and absolute Command. Founding and Pureblood lines show enhanced stability and strong bonds. Modified Lineages exhibit unpredictable traits and instability. Pack bonds are biologically reinforced across all classifications.

39.content: Werewolf society comprises six nested hierarchical layers: Species (Werewolf), Bloodline (Biological Genetics), House (Macro-Politics), Pack (Immediate Social Unit), Family (Kinship Group), Individual. This absolute structure governs all societal interactions.

40.comment: Tier 1 - LSE_Appendix - Bloodline vs. House vs. Pack
40.content: Bloodlines, Houses, and Packs operate as independent vectors. A Bloodline dictates genetics and shared ancestry. A House dictates macro-politics, governance, territorial claims, and alliances. A Pack dictates daily social bonds, family units, and mutual care. A single Pack mixes multiple Bloodlines. A single House governs dozens of Packs. A single Bloodline spans multiple Houses globally.

41.content: Lords serve as absolute leaders of major family branches within a House. Each Lord governs a specific territory or vital functional domain—military, extreme commerce, or diplomacy. Lords answer solely to the House Head. This hierarchy operates within the Bloodmoon Dynasty of Svartúlfr.

42.content: A Citizen is an officially acknowledged member of the House lacking the rank of officer, lord, or sworn knight. Citizens comprise common bloodlines living under absolute House protection.

46.content: LSE Timeline defines seven sequential historical ages. Mythic Age covers species origin and Fenris; history entirely unknown. Age of the Firstborn marks the Nine Firstborn's appearance and formal founding of first packs. Age of Expansion details violent pack spread across Scandinavia, Europe, and globally. Age of Houses codifies Noble Houses and strict Pureblood Houses. Age of Kingdoms represents peak open werewolf civilization governing massive territories. Age of Secrecy initiates the Great Hiding from humanity enforcing total supernatural concealment. Modern Era characterizes contemporary society via corporate fronts, urban packs, and forced coexistence.

47.comment: Tier 1 - LSE_Appendix - The True Pureblood — A Historical Event
47.content: The True Pureblood designates the nine Firstborn werewolves. Recorded History confirms their emergence during the Viking Age. Three Firstborn survive today: Wulfnic, Ut, and Zefir, each exceeding 1,100 years of biological immortality. True Purebloods possess extreme regeneration unmatched by standard werewolves. They maintain perfect stability across all three forms. Their absolute pheromonal aura crushes any other secondary sex. Their Alpha Command physically cannot be resisted by standard werewolves. True Purebloods were never bitten or infected; they were fundamentally remade. Religious Canon claims Fenris forged them from mortal warriors. Unknown Truth leaves their ultimate origin permanently ambiguous.

48.comment: Tier 1 - LSE_Appendix - The Founding of the First Packs
48.content: The Nine Firstborn violently dispersed across the Norse world during the Viking Age. Each Firstborn founded a distinct pack. These packs evolved into Pureblood Houses. Pureblood Houses formalized into Noble Houses. The Nine Firstborn established all Pack Authority structures. The Nine Firstborn defined absolute territorial boundaries. The Nine Firstborn codified the core oral traditions of the Faith of Fenris.

49.comment: Tier 1 - LSE_Appendix - The Age of Expansion
49.content: Werewolf descendants multiplied rapidly. Packs aggressively expanded beyond Scandinavia. Expansion reached Northern Europe, the British Isles, and Slavic lands. Packs moved south to the Mediterranean. Wulfnic led a 1025 AD expedition to North America. Every expansion forged new cultural branches. All branches remained strictly tethered to Founding Houses bloodlines.

50.comment: Tier 1 - LSE_Appendix - The Age of Houses
50.content: The Age of Houses marks the era where territorial expansion forced formal political structuring. Pureblood Houses aggressively consolidated into Noble Houses with rigid governance. House Councils emerged to control multi-pack territories. Complex inter-House diplomacy established the first treaties and marriage pacts. The framework strictly codified absolute distinctions: Bloodline defines pure genetics; House defines political allegiance; Pack defines the immediate social unit.

51.content: The Modern Era defines the Douglas-Bloodmoon dynasty's formation. In 1994, La Grande Caccia confirmed the final White Moon bond uniting Erik Douglas (Pureblood) and Nixara Bloodmoon (Pureblood House). In 1996, formal marriage fused Pureblood political infrastructure with Founding genetic supremacy. In 2005, Nixara died giving birth to twins (User/Alyssa and Jasper). Erik Douglas's subsequent trauma violently reshaped the family dynamic into the Golden Cage.

Their existence is documented Recorded History, not Religious Canon or legend.

53.content: Wulfnic, Ut, and Zefir constitute The Last Three. They collectively embody the three absolute foundations of werewolf existence: Family, Industry, and Spirituality.

67.comment: Tier 1 - LSE_Appendix - The Six-Axis Identity System
